## A reproducible site, not a static scrapbook

The project source, rendered pages, and deployment configuration live together so every published update can be traced back to code.
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

studio <- data.frame(
  value = c("02", "04", "100%"),
  label = c("learning tracks", "site sections", "reproducible"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cards <- paste0(
  '<div class="metric"><strong>', studio$value,
  '</strong><span>', studio$label, '</span></div>',
  collapse = ""
)
cat('<div class="metric-grid">', cards, '</div>')
```
